comments: 70f4c8d9: This routine handles the summarization and checking of discharge summaries in the VistA system.
d9a54d1b: This procedure checks if a discharge summary needs to be added or if one exists for the given patient, date, and parameters.
e80b5266: Initialize local variable for output.
aee77029: Retrieve parameters for discharge summaries from the division settings.
7d4752d2: Exit the procedure if the division settings are not defined.
e0cd6ac8: Set the default type for the document to 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY' if not already specified.
33897e25: If a record with the given ID exists and has no date/time recorded, flag it for update.
5446a70f: Exit the check if a valid record is already present, to avoid duplicates.
7b552386: Iterate through documents for the patient to find a match by type and admission number.
993c1182: Flag and exit the loop if a matching document is found.
79eea9f6: If no existing record is found, proceed to add a new discharge summary.
4fd1a771: End of the CHECK procedure.
f53d4995: This subroutine adds a new discharge summary record for the patient.
9d79c912: Declare local variables for the ADD subroutine.
cb8b184a: Determine the service related to the patient's ward.
48147690: If the service isn't defined, default to the first entry in the file.
cd564392: Determine the specialty of the patient's last movement.
93254169: Set the common variables for the document creation.
dd8aac1d: Set the attending physician based on division parameters.
35b53276: Determine event date and associated ward for the document.
56cb13c3: Create a new file entry in the discharge summary file.
87a7e99c: Exit if the new record could not be created.
f941e208: Attempt to lock the new record for editing.
561b49a0: Set the fields for the new discharge summary record.
872c1bc2: Perform the filing operation to store the document details.
2dcf4627: Unlock the record after editing.
ea0f9b67: Flag the operation as successful.
471fca2e: Procedure for editing discharge summary fields.
8f6c290b: Attempt to lock the record for editing.
4509d56f: Set the fields for the discharge summary update.
98e6fbb5: Execute the filing operation and update the document status.
f6de194c: Unlock the record after editing.
665ab386: End of the EDIT procedure.
36aaa27d: Procedure to delete specific fields from a discharge summary.
a75cd078: Attempt to lock the document for deletion of fields.
ebc89854: Clear the specified fields from the document.
0f8d0bb3: Perform the filing operation and update the status.
947cf24a: Unlock the document after deletion operation.
5b79313f: End of the DCSDEL procedure.
d226777b: Procedure for updating signature blocks in the discharge summary.
d5e9397a: Attempt to lock the document for updating signature information.
e214345a: Set the signature block fields in the discharge summary.
b69017fc: Execute the filing operation and update the status accordingly.
334566d6: Unlock the document after the update operation.
3733bbe6: End of the SIGUP procedure.
3f8e1d4f: Procedure to update the status of a discharge summary based on certain criteria.
2f3784a3: Declare local variables for status update.
7450ebc8: Retrieve the 'DT' node for the document.
1d2a3221: Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if no date is present.
d443207a: Set status to 'DICTATED' if no transcription date is present.
75942ac9: Set status to 'TRANSCRIBED' if not signed.
dac04369: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if review is not required.
ff7f009a: Set status to 'SIGNED' if signed but not reviewed.
08ce7333: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if document review is required and completed.
8d04382e: Update the status field in the document record.
59b8510d: End of the STAT1 procedure.
a23c4e9a: Subroutine to set document variables based on parameters and patient movement.
78260e0d: Retrieve the parameter based on the document type.
cf98c30b: Set the document type based on the parameter and patient movement information.
f38c122e: End of the DOC subroutine.
